verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack describes code search. Only community comments show that GitHub offers code search: one notes logins became required to search code, another calls the search 'terribly bad' and says cloning and grepping is more efficient. Scope across multiple repositories is never evidenced. Missing for 10: first-party docs for code search, evidence of searching across repositories, query syntax/filters, API or CLI code search, positive hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search code across repositories

citations.quote: Microsoft required logins to search code just 48 hours after the acquisition
it's more efficient to clone a repo and use plain grep than to search code on GitHub
